acnh.intro: Sasha is a lazy rabbit villager in the. He was added to as part of the on November 4, 2021, and he was added to between the announcement and release of the update. His catchphrase, "hoppity," is a nonsense variation of the word "hop," which is related to his species.
acnh.appearance: Sasha is a mint-green rabbit with white-tipped ears, feet, and muzzle, a sunny yellow tail, and blond bangs on his forehead. Round dark blue eyes hold sparkles; a tiny eyelash sticks from each outer corner. Orange inner ears and shocked gray pupils with deep blue centers finish a look that feels freshly minted and camera-ready.
acnh.personality: Sasha keeps lazy ease — friendly, food-loving, gently humorous, and slow to take offense even when talk turns silly. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually get along with his relaxed pace; snooty and jock personalities may clash with naps and snacks that define his days. Eleven to eight is his sleep cycle, unhurried as his greeting, with naivete that reads charming rather than careless once you know him.
